wire.headline: Veridion Chemicals to Shut Deeside Facility by 2027
sentences: Veridion Chemicals has announced plans to close its Deeside plant by March 2027.
The closure is expected to affect 4,800 direct jobs at the facility.
CEO Julian Vane attributed the decision to margin pressure following a 12% drop.
Shares fell 8.5p to 42.10p on the day of the announcement.
The total cost of the redundancy package is valued at 310m GBP.
The board approved the plan during an emergency session on 4 November.

ND.headline: Massive plant closure set to impact 4,800 jobs as union prepares for industrial action

sentences.text: The upcoming closure of the facility is set to directly impact 4,800 jobs at the site.
Pointing to a 12% decline in performance, Julian Vane, the CEO, cited margin pressure as the cause for the choice.
A local newspaper report has indicated that 1,200 indirect jobs are also at risk from the closure.
The plant was originally opened in 1998 with an initial investment of 500m GBP.
The company's history reveals three previous leadership changes since 2010.
The Unite union has confirmed a ballot of 2,400 members regarding a potential strike.
Union representative Marcus Thorne described the leadership's stance as tone deaf.
Staff members expect to receive their final pay by 15 December following their exit.
The regional council has allocated 25m GBP for retraining programs to assist affected workers.
Local MP Richard Kestrel has demanded an inquiry into the decision to close the plant.
